list.demosText: Each one plays a short demo with its own sample notes; then it’s your turn. Nothing is saved: a reload starts the demo over.
list.featuresText: These need a server or another app, so there’s nothing to play here.

player.nudge: Short demos show each feature, then it’s your turn.

freeze.title: Freeze a note
freeze.summary: Nobody can change, trash or delete it until its owner unfreezes it.
freeze.outro: Try it: freeze a note, then try to type in it or move it to the trash.

say.s1: Open a note you want to keep as it is.
say.s2: In the More menu, choose Freeze.
say.s3: Frozen: the text can’t be edited, and the note can’t be trashed or deleted.
say.s4: Unfreeze it from the same menu.
say.s5: Now it can be edited again.

copy.title: Make a copy
copy.summary: Copy a note, with its pictures and attachments.
copy.outro: Try it: copy a note, then change the copy.

say.s1: Open a note.
say.s3: The copy sits next to the original.

drag.title: Drag notes into order
drag.summary: Arrange notes as in Google Keep: the others make room, and a moved note stays put.
drag.outro: Try it: drag a note to another place. It stays there until you edit it.

say.s1: Pick a note up and drag it where you want it.
say.s2: The other notes made room, and the order is kept.

bulk-colour.title: Colour many notes at once
bulk-colour.summary: Select several notes and give them one colour.
bulk-colour.outro: Try it: select notes, then use the bar at the bottom.

say.s1: Choose Select…
say.s3: Colour changes all of them at once.

tick-from-list.title: Tick items from the list
tick-from-list.summary: Tick checklist items straight from the notes list.
tick-from-list.outro: Try it: tick and untick items on the cards.

say.s1: No need to open a checklist to tick it off.
say.s2: The ticks are saved; the cards stay where they are.

checkboxes.title: Checkbox tools
checkboxes.summary: Show or hide checkboxes, uncheck all items, delete checked items.
checkboxes.outro: Try it: tick some items, then use More › Delete checked items or Uncheck all.

say.s1: Open a checklist.
say.s3: Hide checkboxes turns it into plain lines…
say.s4: …and Show checkboxes back into a list.
say.s5: With items ticked, More › Delete checked items clears them away.

filters.title: Search filters
filters.summary: Filter by colour, tag, pictures, checklists and reminders.
filters.outro: Try it: combine filters with a search.

say.s1: Filter narrows the list down.
say.s3: Add a colour…
say.s4: …or a tag. Filters are kept in the address, so Back returns to them.

search-archive.title: Search finds archived notes
search-archive.summary: Search also lists archived notes; Archive and Trash can be searched.
search-archive.outro: Try it: archive a note, then search for it from Notes.

say.s1: A search on Notes also finds archived ones…
say.s2: …and Archive and Trash have their own search.

search-marks.title: Searched words marked
search-marks.summary: The words you searched for are marked in the note you open.
search-marks.outro: Try it: search, then open a result.

say.s1: Search for a word…
say.s3: The word is marked in the text. Typing clears the marks.

search-kept.title: Search kept on the way back
search-kept.summary: Open a note from a search; Back returns to the same search.
search-kept.outro: Try it: search, open a note, then press Back.

say.s1: Search for something…
say.s3: …and go back: the search is still there.

tag-archived.title: Tags count archived notes
tag-archived.summary: A tag’s count includes its archived notes, and the tag lists them.
tag-archived.outro: Try it: archive a tagged note, then open its tag.

say.s1: Travel counts 2 notes: one of them is archived.
say.s3: …the archived one included, so nothing tagged goes missing.

paste-picture.title: Paste a picture
paste-picture.summary: Paste a picture into a note’s text, then resize it by its corner.
paste-picture.outro: Try it: copy a picture or take a screenshot, paste it in a note, then drag its corner.

say.s1: Copy a picture, open a note…
say.s2: …and paste it with Ctrl+V: it goes in where the caret is.
say.s3: Too big? Drag the dot at its corner…
say.s4: …and it keeps that size, on every device.

attach-file.title: Attach any file
attach-file.summary: Attach files of any kind to a note, not only pictures and audio.
attach-file.outro: Try it: attach a file to a note, or drop one on it.

say.s1: In a note, Picture or audio…
say.s2: …takes any kind of file, not only pictures and recordings.
say.s3: They sit with the note and download with a click.

tags.title: Tag colours and order
tags.summary: Change a tag’s colour from its menu; drag tags into any order.
tags.outro: Try it: hover a tag, then drag its handle or open its menu.

say.s1: Each tag’s menu has its colour.
say.s2: Move a tag by dragging its handle, or with the arrow keys.
say.s3: The new order syncs to your other devices.

text-style.title: Text colour, fonts and highlights
text-style.summary: Colour text, change its font, and highlight in any colour.
text-style.outro: Try it: select text, then use the toolbar or the bubble above it.

say.s1: Open a note and select some words.
say.s3: …and a font.

burn.title: Notes burn away
burn.summary: A deleted note burns away like a destroyed card in Balatro.
burn.outro: Try it: delete a note. Settings › Editor turns the effect off.

say.s1: Select a note…
say.s3: It went to the trash; Undo brings it back.

pictures.title: Pictures on cards
pictures.summary: View a card’s picture full size, or hide pictures on cards.
pictures.outro: Try it: open a picture, or paste one into a note.

say.s1: Click a card’s picture to see it full size.
say.s3: View › Pictures on cards hides them.

pictures-in-text.title: Pictures in the text
pictures-in-text.summary: Put pictures in the text; resize them by a corner, right-click to crop, mirror or caption them.
pictures-in-text.outro: Try it: right-click a picture to crop it, or put one in the text with the picture button.

say.s1: Open a note with pictures in its text.
say.s2: Hover a picture: drag the dot at its corner to resize it.
say.s3: Right-click one (or hold it) for more.
say.s4: Mirrored, cropped or replaced, it keeps its size and caption.
say.s6: …and the picture button left of the text styles puts new ones at the caret.

image-text.title: Grab text from a picture
image-text.summary: Select the text in a picture, copy it or insert it in the note.
image-text.outro: Try it: open the picture and draw a box around some words.

say.s1: Open a picture…
say.s2: …and grab its text. It is read in your browser.
say.s3: Select words by dragging, or all of them.
say.s4: Insert in note adds the text to the note.

history.title: Version history
history.summary: Each version shows its added and removed lines; restore any of them.
history.outro: Try it: edit the note, then look at its history again.

say.s1: Open a note with some history.
say.s3: Each version shows what was added (+) and removed (−).
say.s4: Restore brings a version back; Undo is at hand.

appearance.title: Colour schemes and themes
appearance.summary: Nord, Dracula, OLED and more, and themes of your own.
appearance.outro: Try it: Settings › Appearance. A reload goes back to the default.

say.s1: Pick a colour scheme…
say.s2: OLED is pure black in dark mode.
say.s3: A custom theme can be pasted as JSON, too.

custom-theme.title: Custom theme from JSON
custom-theme.summary: Paste a theme as JSON; the same JSON works on Android.
custom-theme.outro: Try it: Settings › Appearance › Copy current theme as JSON, then change a colour.

say.s1: Settings › Appearance › Custom theme takes a theme as JSON.
say.s2: Apply, and its colours replace the scheme’s.
say.s3: Colours it leaves out are the scheme’s. Reset removes it.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.summary: Google Keep’s shortcuts: c for a new note, / to search, Esc, e, f, #.
shortcuts.outro: Try it: press c, write something, then Esc.

say.s1: c starts a new note…
say.s3: / jumps to the search.
say.s4: In an opened note: e archives, f pins, # moves it to the trash.

date.title: Insert today’s date
date.summary: Type /date, or press Ctrl+; for the date (Ctrl+Shift+; with the time).
date.outro: Try it: type /date in a note.

say.s1: In a note…
say.s3: …and so does /date.
say.s4: Settings › Editor offers 2026-10-28 instead, and your own shortcut.

lock.title: Lock a note
lock.summary: Lock a note with a tap, a PIN, a pattern or your fingerprint.
lock.outro: Try it: Settings › Note locks sets a PIN or pattern.

say.s1: Open a note…
say.s3: A locked note shows only its title…
say.s4: …and opens with a tap (or your PIN, pattern or password).

quick-writing.title: Writing straight away
quick-writing.summary: A new note opens with the cursor in its text; Tab goes from the title to the text.
quick-writing.outro: Try it: press n anywhere for a new note.

say.s1: A new note opens ready to type.
say.s3: …Tab goes on to the text.

send.title: Send a note as text
send.summary: Send a note to other apps as text, checklists as ☐ and ☑.
send.outro: Try it: send a note, then paste it somewhere.

say.s1: Open a note.
say.s2: More › Send shares it as text, or copies it.
say.s3: Checklists come out as ☐ and ☑ lines.

mcp.title: Claude and other MCP apps
mcp.summary: Claude, and other apps that speak MCP, can search, read and write your notes through your server.

sync.title: Sync across devices
sync.summary: Edit offline on the web or your phone; changes sync when you’re back online.

sharing.title: Share notes
sharing.summary: Share a note with other people on your server, to read or edit.

picture-text-search.title: Search the text in pictures
picture-text-search.summary: Search finds the words in screenshots and receipts, read on the server.

picture-search.title: Find notes by their pictures
picture-search.summary: Opt-in: search for what pictures show (“receipt”, “Katzen”), in most languages.

oidc.title: Sign in with OIDC
oidc.summary: Sign in through Pocket ID, Authelia, Keycloak and the like.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.summary: Set a time on any note and get a notification on your phone, once or repeating.

share-to.title: Share to Anchor+
share-to.summary: Send text, links, pictures and files to Anchor+ from other apps.

desktop-app.title: Desktop app
desktop-app.summary: Your server’s web client in its own window on Windows and macOS, updating itself.
